text.p: Bristol-Myers Squibb Co said its Mead Johnson Nutritionals division has named Ian Stuart president, effective May 1.
Stuart succeeds Nutritionals and Medical Devices Group president Peter Dolan, who will devote his time to the larger responsibility of the Nutritional and Medical Devices Group.
Prior to joining Bristol-Myers, Stuart held international management positions with Gillette, Cheseborough-Ponds and Unilever in Europe, Japan and Africa.
Mead Johnson Nutritionals is a world leader in infant formulas, medical nutritionals and consumer nutritional products. It employs 5,200 people worldwide and is headquartered in Evansville, Indiana.
